 Our Story
 The perfect place for quality import and export.
 Cremalat Cheese started with a humble beginning in 1993 from Claudio and Margaret Giustizieri, both of Italian origin that shared a love for Italian food.
 This story started at the Michael Mount Organic Market in Bryanston, with a small cheese stall. Through word of mouth, the business slowly grew around the Italian community in Johannesburg and Pretoria. Day-by-day, the demand of Italian products grew so Claudio and Margaret decided to expand their lines by importing other Italian products such as cold meats, coffee, pasta, tomatoes, water, wine, olive oil and more.
 Eventually a new venue was bought in 1996, in Kensington. The new venue became a point of reference for the variety of cheeses and Italian products that were distributed throughout Johannesburg and Pretoria, a well-equipped delicatessen was added to the business. Read more 
 Deli & Bakery
 Authentic Italian Delicatessen
 Since 1992, Cremalat is proudly an Authentic Italian Delicatessen offering to the loyal clients a wide selection of the best Italian products
 The products are imported from various regions in Italy including: wines from Friuli Venezia Giulia, Prosecco from Valdobbiadine, Prosciutto Crudo from Parma, Parmigiano-Reggiano, Limoncello, Panettone, Olive oil, Pasta, Biscotti, Cioccolato, Torrone, Colomba Pasquale and more from various regions of Italy
 Our deli is well know for the great selection of freshly sliced cold meats and a wide selection of 80 different gourmet cheeses imported as well as locally produced. Two of our cheeses are award winning namely, the famous Cremalat Gorgonzola & the Drunken Pecorino. Our products can be found in both our Johannesburg and Pretoria delis.
 On the 19 of September 2018 after a huge renovation the Deli has been upgraded, giving to our clients an even greater space to shop at their leisure. La Panetteria (the bakery) has been introduced to offer a wide selection of homemade breads that compliments the range of Cremalat deli products. Fresh ciabatta, sourdough bread, focaccia, panzerotti and many more can be found freshly baked, every day.

 THE PINNACLE OF LUXURY DINING 
WHERE THE EXPERIENCE STIRS THE SOUL
 High above Johannesburg, a world apart from the ordinary, lies The 11th Floor, Africa’s most extraordinary rooftop restaurant and cocktail bar.
 Here, fine dining becomes theatre.
 Each plate, each pour, each note of live music is composed to stir emotion and heighten presence. It is not a meal, it is a moment, choreographed with precision, expressed through beauty, and remembered long after the night ends.
 The menu draws inspiration from the hills of Florence, where timeless Italian craftsmanship meets modern Mediterranean fire. Every ingredient is hand chosen, every flavour balanced with intention. From truffle laced pastas to flame kissed seafood, each dish tells a story of artistry and obsession.
 And then, the bar.
